notes: Not measured pending the author's decision on the 1,3A- claim role: flavonols also give C7H3O4- (Yang 2012 p. 497, Table 3), isoflavones would by calculation, and the weak 1,3B- (1-2 % for apigenin) is then the only class-specific ion.

competitors.note: genistein (C15H10O5, as apigenin) would give the same 1,3A- and 1,3B- formulas by calculation; Fabre 2001 saw no RDA ion for it and Yang 2012 p. 497 found RDA cleavage difficult for isoflavones, but Vukics 2010 p. 10 cite Kuhn 2003 as not confirming this; biochanin A shares C16H12O5 with genkwanin

galangin shares C15H10O5 with apigenin, and its 1,3A- and 1,3B- would have the same formulas (C7H3O4-, C8H5O-; by calculation); Yang 2012 Table 3 (p. 498) print 1,3A- 151 at 65 % for kaempferol and 55 % for quercetin
